positions.title: Mentor / Driver
positions.description: Getting people where they need to go and mentoring new drivers on how to Lyft properly.

positions.title: Associate Application Developer
positions.description: Created and maintained PHP based websites using Drupal, Expression Engine and Wordpress CMSs, and custom sites built in PHP, Ruby. Experience with C#.Net and dabbled in many frameworks including Sitecore, Kentico, Shine, and custom ASP sites. Worked with all levels of the LAMP stack.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: During this brief interim internship, I familiarized myself with an enormous 20-year-old codebase and started writing tests for some C# code. I refined and documented a process for creating a backup copy of one client's product.

positions.title: Programming Intern
positions.description: I wrote many scripts to populate the database with the job opportunities that were listed on our clients' websites. While there, I identified and helped eradicate a large attack on our system by hackers in Russia.

projects.title: Triangle National Leadership Hub
projects.description: A project for the National Triangle Fraternity Headquarters to simplify the organization of leadership events. This website allows them to distribute information about upcoming leadership events and get volunteers and attendees to sign up.

projects.title: UWM Triangle Fraternity Website
projects.description: The homepage for the Triangle Fraternity at the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee. This website has gone through multiple iterations to find the system that works the best for the fraternity.
